description: This file defines utility functions for Windows platform integration within a Flutter project, including console creation, UTF-16 to UTF-8 string conversion, and command line argument retrieval.

methods.name: CreateAndAttachConsole
methods.description: Creates a console for the process and redirects stdout and stderr to it for both the runner and the Flutter library.

methods.name: Utf8FromUtf16
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated wchar_t* string encoded in UTF-16 to a std::string encoded in UTF-8, returning an empty string on failure.

methods.name: GetCommandLineArguments
methods.description: Retrieves command line arguments as a vector of UTF-8 encoded std::string objects, returning an empty vector on failure.
